discriminatingEvidence.plugVersusSocket: Printed pages 3–5, figures 1–4; inspect mating geometry independently of board-hole spacing.

conclusions: Detailed form and board-hole drawings are available; obtaining them is no longer a prerequisite.

The common PCB pattern permits a conditional board-plane calibration without selecting housing width. Use held-out landmarks and propagate picking uncertainty; do not use fitted X1 holes as independent validation.
The common hole pattern cannot distinguish the four forms or authorize body dimensions, numbered terminal identities, mating clearance or historical pad moves.
nextCheck: Fit the common pattern to primary underside joint observations and test independent held-out board-plane landmarks, including extrapolation uncertainty. Keep existing registration acceptance limits.
